title: BenCzechMark: A Czech-centric Multitask and Multimetric Benchmark for Large Language Models with Duel Scoring Mechanism

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the correlation between the token length of predicted choices and ground truth choices in multiple-choice formats, comparing different log-probability aggregation methods (sum vs. mean).
Evaluating models on automatically translated English factoid QA datasets (TriviaQA, NaturalQuestions) to test for the retention of Anglocentric knowledge after Czech-centric fine-tuning.
